raw_turns.text: Last night I joined a fantasy literature forum and had a great talk about my fave books. It was so enriching!

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a man holding a surfboard on a beach] I had an awesome summer with my friends, surfing and riding the waves. The feeling was unreal!

raw_turns.speaker: Tim
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a person riding a surfboard on a body of water] Wow! That sounds amazing! The connection to nature must be incredible.
